I think this is due to https://github.com/protobufjs/protobuf.js/issues/1754. Not sure if you have the rest of the stack trace as that would be helpful to confirm.

The fix is in, but `@protobufjs/inquire` has not been released. If you cannot wait you could check out https://www.npmjs.com/package/@untra/dontinquire which was specifically made to avoid that `eval` statement.

> This is the message I get when building
> ...
> Critical dependency: the request of a dependency is an expression

@bonadio That error message can only happen if you try to bundle the Temporal client package with Webpack. You specifically indicated that you're _building_ your application. What is that build process, exactly?

You may need to add `@temporalio/client` package to some "externals" or "excluded modules" list in your bundler's configuration, then make sure that package and its dependencies are available as regular packages in your application `node_modules` at run time.
